leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic TypeScript interface for API response data
Construct a custom React hook with generic type parameters
Initialize state variables to manage loading, error, and data states
Manipulate the hook's internal logic to handle different data types
Apply the generic useFetch hook to fetch user data from an API
Integrate the hook's return values into component rendering logic
Configure the hook to accept different endpoint URLs dynamically
